name: Tougou Asuma
source:
The third son of the influential Tougou family. After graduating from university, he joined a major company owned by his father. Talented and quick to stand out, he now serves as the company’s Head of Sales at the main office.
He inherited the role of supporting Sonogi from his father, but his sharp business acumen means he tends to look down on the younger politician. Their first meeting went badly.
Because his company is a sponsor of the 2020 International Athlete Festival (IAF), he has taken a hardline stance, insisting the terrorist threat must be stopped at all costs.

[Translated from [url=https://holicworks.net/24ku/mainchara.html]the official website[/url].]
